title: RAF Canberra Mark-PR3 reconnaissance aircraft in flight, Chapter 1 p. 6
description: Black-and-white photograph of two RAF Canberra twin-engine jet aircraft with roundel markings flying in formation, one above the other, over terrain. Captioned "RAF Canberra Mark-PR3." Accompanying text discusses the Air Force review of Leghorn's modified Canberra design, which led to the RB-57D.
